name: Great Tree Pharmacy Co., Ltd.
summary: Great Tree Pharmacy Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise that operates an extensive chain of pharmacies throughout the island nation. These retail outlets offer a broad selection of goods, including prescription and over-the-counter medications, nutritional supplements, products specifically for mothers and infants, and various cosmetics. Beyond its retail presence, the company also delivers comprehensive medication procurement and coordination services to medical establishments such as individual clinics, shared outpatient facilities, and larger integrated healthcare networks. Furthermore, Great Tree Pharmacy acts as an agent for these same medical institutions, assisting them in the distribution and sale of popular health and wellness products sourced both domestically and internationally. Established in 2001, the company was initially named Tianjin Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. before rebranding to its current designation. Its main corporate offices are located in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
